dct_title_s: Administrative Boundaries (Digital Map Database of China)
dct_description_sm: Abstract: Polygon coverage of administrative boundaries of China which includes region codes, national and international boundaries and divisions, islands and ocean areas.

Purpose: These data are intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and to provide users with geographic data for cartography, socio-political and economic analysis and other types of geographic analysis. Data can be used with geographic information systems (GIS) software to display and analyze political and administrative regions in China, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data.
